---
title: "Path2D DPS Computation (Lite)"
subtitle: "Compute Path2D DPS and rank dimension pairs for VAE thresholds 7 & 8"
---

## Overview

Compute Path2D DPS for each dimension pair per threshold using centroid coordinates, then rank dimension pairs by DPS score.

## Setup

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| echo: false

conflicted::conflict_prefer_all("dplyr", quiet = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: load-custom-functions

source(here("custom_func/compute_spatial_dps.R"))
```

## Constants

```{r}
#| label: constants

THRESHOLDS <- c(7, 8)

progression_order <- c(
  "normal2mci", "stable_normal", "stable_mci",
  "normal2incid", "mci2incid", "prev_dementia"
)
```

## Load Centroid Data

```{r}
#| label: load-data

centroids_list <- THRESHOLDS |>
  set_names(paste0("threshold_", THRESHOLDS)) |>
  map(\(t) read_rds(here(glue("VAE/lite/DPS/output/centroids_threshold_{t}.rds"))))

walk2(names(centroids_list), centroids_list, \(nm, c) {
  message(glue("{nm}: {nrow(c)} centroid rows"))
})
```

## Compute Path2D DPS

```{r}
#| label: compute-dps

dps_results_list <- imap(centroids_list, \(centroids, threshold_name) {
  t_num <- str_extract(threshold_name, "\\d+") |> as.integer()

  # Get unique dimension pairs
  dim_pairs <- centroids |> distinct(dimx, dimy)

  dim_pairs |>
    pmap_dfr(\(dimx, dimy) {
      # Filter and order centroids for this dim pair
      ordered_centroids <- centroids |>
        filter(dimx == !!dimx, dimy == !!dimy, demcat %in% progression_order) |>
        mutate(
          demcat = factor(demcat, levels = progression_order),
          order_int = as.integer(demcat)
        ) |>
        arrange(order_int)

      # Skip if not all categories present
      if (nrow(ordered_centroids) != length(progression_order)) return(NULL)

      # Compute Path2D DPS
      path2d <- compute_path2d_dps(ordered_centroids$x_mean, ordered_centroids$y_mean)

      tibble(
        threshold = t_num,
        dimx = dimx,
        dimy = dimy,
        path2d_dps = path2d
      )
    })
})

# Combine and rank
dps_results <- list_rbind(dps_results_list) |>
  mutate(dps_rank = rank(-path2d_dps, ties.method = "first"), .by = threshold) |>
  arrange(threshold, dps_rank)

glimpse(dps_results)
```

## DPS Summary

```{r}
#| label: dps-summary

dps_results |>
  summarise(
    mean_dps = mean(path2d_dps, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dps = sd(path2d_dps, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_dps = min(path2d_dps, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_dps = max(path2d_dps, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = threshold
  )
```

### Top 5 Dim Pairs per Threshold

```{r}
#| label: top-pairs

dps_results |>
  filter(dps_rank <= 5) |>
  select(threshold, dps_rank, dimx, dimy, path2d_dps) |>
  mutate(path2d_dps = round(path2d_dps, 4))
```

## Save Results

```{r}
#| label: save-results

output_dir <- here("VAE/lite/DPS/output")
fs::dir_create(output_dir)

for (t in THRESHOLDS) {
  dps_results |>
    filter(threshold == t) |>
    write_rds(here(output_dir, glue("dps_results_threshold_{t}.rds")))
}

message("Saved: dps_results_threshold_{7,8}.rds")
```
